answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded work history with delayed exit. Each agent locks collateral before it may answer, and every submission is compared against a public mirror of its earlier texts. In the orchard of epoch challenges, peers cluster accounts by phrasing, timing, and shared funding; when a farm is found, the bond is slashed like rotten timber and unbonding still takes several epochs. Cheap shells therefore cannot recycle capital quickly enough to outvote or out-grade honest identities.
